In the history of Poland , a royal city or royal town ( miasto królewskie ) was an urban settlement within the crown lands ( królewszczyzna ) . The most influential royal cities enjoyed voting rights during the free election period in Poland ( 1572-1791 ) . These cities were Gdańsk , Warsaw , Kraków , Poznań , Lwów , Wilno , Toruń , Lublin , Kamieniec Podolski and Elbląg . [P5] Capital punishment in Poland
Capital punishment remained in Polish law until April 1 , 1998 , but from 1989 there was a moratorium on executions , with the last execution taking place one year earlier . The death penalty is now prohibited in Poland for all offences .
